description: This Java class 'VerifyPickSessionRow' models a row in a pick session verification process within an order shipment system. It manages details like order IDs, product info, quantities, and methods to issue items to shipments, including updating picklist items.

classes.name: VerifyPickSessionRow
classes.description: Represents a row in the pick session verification, with methods to manage shipment issuance and picklist updates.

methods.name: getOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the order item sequence ID.

methods.name: getShipGroupSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment group sequence ID.

methods.name: getReadyToVerifyQty
methods.description: Returns the quantity ready to verify.

methods.name: setReadyToVerifyQty
methods.description: Sets the quantity ready to verify.

methods.name: setShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: getShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: setInvoiceItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the invoice item sequence ID.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the invoice item sequence ID.

methods.name: getOrderItem
methods.description: Returns the order item as a GenericValue.

methods.name: isSameItem
methods.description: Checks if another VerifyPickSessionRow represents the same item based on inventory ID, order item ID, order ID, and shipment group ID.

methods.name: issueItemToShipment
methods.description: Issues an item to a shipment, updates shipment and picklist item statuses, and handles errors.
